intents.reason: The next pre-1.0 minor removes caller-supplied lexical import hints, requires exact Rust-authored declaration identities for style resolution, preserves analyzed-empty reachability as a closed-world result, and projects typed dialect-cycle evidence instead of a generic pass-unavailable blocker.
